name: Sudo Commands Run in a Pseudo-Terminal
description:
Ensures sudoers sets 'Defaults use_pty', so commands run through sudo cannot keep running in the background and inject input into the user's terminal after sudo exits. sudo 1.9.14 and later enable use_pty by default; on those versions this rule documents the setting explicitly.
Required sudo rule: allow user lea to run ONLY this exact command without a password: lea ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: /bin/cat /etc/sudoers /etc/sudoers.d/*
